# `is_valid_variant`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if the variant is valid, false if it is malformed, NULL if `v` is NULL.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.2 and later.

## Syntax

```text
is_valid_variant(v)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- is_valid_variant, example 1
> SELECT is_valid_variant(parse_json('null'));
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- is_valid_variant, example 2
> SELECT is_valid_variant(parse_json('[{"b":true,"a":0}]'));
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.2.0.
